title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Numbers 6: the vow of the Nazirite, its offerings, and the blessing Aaron and his sons were to speak over Israel.

questions.text: From what must a Nazirite separate himself?
questions.explanation: A man or woman who made the vow of a Nazirite was to separate himself from wine and strong drink.

questions.text: What was the rule for the Nazirite's hair during the days of his vow?
questions.explanation: No razor was to come on his head; he was to let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

answers.text: He had to shave it every seventh day
He had to keep it covered
No razor was to come on his head
He had to cut it at each new moon

questions.text: What was a Nazirite not allowed to go near during his separation?
questions.explanation: All the days that he separated himself to Yahweh he was not to go near a dead body, not even for his father, mother, brother or sister.

questions.text: If someone died suddenly beside a Nazirite, on which day was he to shave his head?
questions.explanation: If a man died very suddenly beside him, he was to shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day.

questions.text: What did the defiled Nazirite bring to the priest on the eighth day?
questions.explanation: On the eighth day he was to bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
A tenth of an ephah of barley meal

questions.text: After his separation was defiled, what happened to the days he had already kept?
questions.explanation: He had to separate the days of his separation again, and the former days were void, because his separation was defiled.

answers.text: They were added to his new vow
They were given to the priest

questions.text: What did the Nazirite do with the hair of his head when his vow was fulfilled?
questions.explanation: He shaved his head at the door of the Tent of Meeting and put the hair on the fire under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

answers.text: He buried it outside the camp
He put it on the fire under the peace offerings
He gave it to the priest as a wave offering
He kept it in the Tent of Meeting

questions.text: After the wave offering at the end of his vow, what was the Nazirite allowed to do?
questions.explanation: After the priest waved the offerings before Yahweh, the Nazirite was allowed to drink wine.

answers.text: Eat the breast of the ram

questions.text: To whom did Yahweh give the words for blessing the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, "This is how you shall bless the children of Israel."

questions.text: Complete the blessing: "Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you..."
questions.explanation: The blessing ends with: "Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace."
